scope: Reject mismatched provider asset identities before quote, current-valuation or single-asset valuation fact mutation and preserve stable DATA-02 failure evidence.
implemented_contract: A shared Application guard uses the Domain normalize_asset_code rule for requested identities and requires provider facts to arrive in canonical numeric-code/exchange form.
Exact batch validation rejects missing, duplicate, substituted, extra, invalid, blank and non-string identities before quote or current-valuation bulk_upsert.
Single-asset valuation accepts zero rows or repeated time-series rows only when every row carries the exact requested canonical identity.
DATA-02 resumable backfill, scheduled full-market refresh, current-fact remediation, generic quote API, decision repair, decision sync and on-demand quote paths enable strict validation.
ProviderAssetIdentityError carries the stable PROVIDER_ASSET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH code and is recorded as provider_asset_identity_mismatch in failed item attempts.
Identity failure never calls the fact repository or publication publisher and leaves the resumable checkpoint at the current offset.
Generic quote API compatibility remains explicit through server-selected strict mode; the client cannot disable the guard.

independent_review.initial_result: No P0 in strict DATA-02 batch paths; four P1 gaps were identified.
resolved_before_commit: Generic quote API now forces exact validation.
Single-asset valuation validates every returned time-series fact before mutation.
The guard reuses Domain asset-code normalization and rejects uncanonicalized provider aliases.
A structured error code maps to durable failed item attempts and a non-advancing checkpoint.
Current-data governance now checks pre-write markers and no-residual tests.
An actual SQLite API/repository test proves a substituted quote leaves no fact row and returns the structured error code.
retained_open_gates: PostgreSQL zero-residual evidence with existing-row preservation remains required.
PostgreSQL concurrent item-attempt begin/recovery/finish evidence remains required.
A 5,533-asset scale run and any needed bulk persistence optimization remain required.
Policy-hash-bound numeric reconciliation tolerance evidence remains required.
Genuine current production authority and explicit production-write authorization remain required.
independent_review.accepted_scope: Repository pre-write guard checkpoint only; DATA-02 remains awaiting_production and no production completion is claimed.

sqlite_repository_zero_residual.assertion: Substituted quote returned HTTP 422 with PROVIDER_ASSET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH, persisted one error audit and zero quote facts.
